# MoE Full-Device ATT Per-SE Results

- Kernel: `moe_gateup_kernel_0`
- Shape: tokens=24576, gate_up=512, K=6144, topk=8, experts=384
- Captured matching-kernel iteration: 8
- `att_shader_engine_mask=0xffffffff`: SE0-SE31
- `att_simd_select=0xf`: all four SIMDs in each selected CU
- Target CU0 is the user-provided baseline; target CU1-CU7 are the seven new captures.

Every target produced 32 raw ATT files and one decoded dispatch. An SE
with no decoded wave is reported as `N/A`, not as zero efficiency. Every
decoded wave passed the 23-iteration mainloop, dynamic-MFMA-count, and
phase-duration checks.

Target CU0 lacks decoded waves on 14 SEs; target CU1 lacks SE8; target
CU7 lacks SE9; target CU2-CU6 decode all 32 SEs. These 16 missing local
CU positions exactly match the difference between 320 nominal CU slots
(32 SE x 10 CU/SE) and the device's 304 active CUs. This strongly supports
CU harvesting as the cause, rather than insufficient grid work.

## Per-SE Tables

Each table aggregates all decoded waves on one local target-CU index but
keeps SE0-SE31 separate. `cycles (share)` is the equal-wave mean and its
fraction of that SE's mean whole-wave lifetime.
